shortDescription: Reusable action card for membership entry points.
fullDescription: Displays a large clickable membership action with a circular icon, emphasized title, and optional muted surface styling. It is designed for dashboard-style launch sections where views need consistent action tiles for creating memberships, resuming pending work, or similar flows.

Renders a membership enrollment screen with a branded top bar, a left step tracker, a personal data section with profile photo placeholder, contact and address forms, an inactive secondary memberships area, and footer actions for returning home, saving progress, and moving to payment. The view reuses the shared button, checkbox, input, label, select, and separator components to keep the registration workflow visually consistent with the rest of the application.
